<?php

use App\Models\Channel;
use App\Models\Video;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Title('Feed')] class extends Component
{
    #[Url]
    public string $design = 'current';

    #[Url]
    public string $filter = 'unwatched';

    #[Url]
    public string $sort = 'newest';

    #[Url]
    public string $channel = '';

    public function with(): array
    {
        $channels = Channel::query()->orderBy('title')->get();

        return [
            'channels' => $channels,
            'selectedChannel' => $channels->firstWhere('youtube_channel_id', $this->channel),
            'videos' => Video::query()->with('channel')
                ->when($this->channel !== '', fn ($q) => $q->whereRelation('channel', 'youtube_channel_id', $this->channel))
                ->when($this->sort === 'oldest', fn ($q) => $q->orderBy('published_at'), fn ($q) => $q->orderByDesc('published_at'))
                ->limit(12)->get(),
            'remaining' => '2:47',
            'sorts' => ['newest' => 'Newest first', 'oldest' => 'Oldest first', 'longest' => 'Longest first', 'shortest' => 'Shortest first'],
            'sortsShort' => ['newest' => 'Newest', 'oldest' => 'Oldest', 'longest' => 'Longest', 'shortest' => 'Shortest'],
            'filters' => ['all' => 'All', 'unwatched' => 'Unwatched', 'saved' => 'Saved'],
        ];
    }
}; ?>

<section class="w-full">
    {{-- ============================================================ CURRENT --}}
    @if ($design === 'current')
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <flux:heading size="xl" level="1">
                Feed
                <span class="font-normal text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">({{ $remaining }}<span class="hidden sm:inline"> remaining</span>)</span>
            </flux:heading>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <flux:text size="sm">Last refreshed 3 minutes ago</flux:text>
                <flux:button icon="arrow-path" variant="subtle">Refresh all</flux:button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <flux:radio.group wire:model.live="filter" variant="segmented" size="sm">
                @foreach ($filters as $value => $label)<flux:radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:radio>@endforeach
            </flux:radio.group>
            <flux:select wire:model.live="sort" size="sm" class="max-w-48">
                @foreach ($sorts as $value => $label)<flux:select.option value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:select.option>@endforeach
            </flux:select>
            <flux:select wire:model.live="channel" size="sm" class="max-w-64">
                <flux:select.option value="">All channels</flux:select.option>
                @foreach ($channels as $option)<flux:select.option value="{{ $option->youtube_channel_id }}">{{ $option->display_name }}</flux:select.option>@endforeach
            </flux:select>
        </div>
    @endif

    {{-- ============================================================ A: TIDY GRID --}}
    @if ($design === 'a')
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
                <flux:heading size="xl" level="1">Feed</flux:heading>
                <flux:text size="sm" class="mt-0.5">{{ $remaining }} left to watch <span class="hidden sm:inline">· refreshed 3 min ago</span></flux:text>
            </div>
            <flux:tooltip content="Refresh all · last refreshed 3 minutes ago">
                <flux:button icon="arrow-path" variant="subtle" class="sm:hidden" aria-label="Refresh all" />
            </flux:tooltip>
            <flux:button icon="arrow-path" variant="subtle" class="max-sm:hidden">Refresh all</flux:button>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:items-center sm:gap-3">
            <flux:radio.group wire:model.live="filter" variant="segmented" size="sm" class="col-span-2 sm:w-80">
                @foreach ($filters as $value => $label)<flux:radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:radio>@endforeach
            </flux:radio.group>
            <flux:select wire:model.live="channel" size="sm" class="min-w-0 sm:ms-auto sm:w-56">
                <flux:select.option value="">All channels</flux:select.option>
                @foreach ($channels as $option)<flux:select.option value="{{ $option->youtube_channel_id }}">{{ $option->display_name }}</flux:select.option>@endforeach
            </flux:select>
            <flux:select wire:model.live="sort" size="sm" class="min-w-0 sm:w-44">
                @foreach ($sorts as $value => $label)<flux:select.option value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:select.option>@endforeach
            </flux:select>
        </div>
    @endif

    {{-- ============================================================ B: TABS + FILTER SHEET --}}
    @if ($design === 'b')
        @php $active = ($sort !== 'newest' ? 1 : 0) + ($channel !== '' ? 1 : 0); @endphp
        <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
            <flux:heading size="xl" level="1">Feed <span class="font-normal text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">· {{ $remaining }} left</span></flux:heading>
            <flux:button icon="arrow-path" variant="ghost" size="sm" class="max-sm:-me-2"><span class="max-sm:hidden">Refresh all</span></flux:button>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-5 flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
            <flux:radio.group wire:model.live="filter" variant="segmented" size="sm" class="flex-1 sm:max-w-80">
                @foreach ($filters as $value => $label)<flux:radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:radio>@endforeach
            </flux:radio.group>

            {{-- Mobile: one button, opens a sheet --}}
            <flux:modal.trigger name="feed-filters" class="sm:hidden">
                <flux:button size="sm" icon="adjustments-horizontal" aria-label="Sort and channel">
                    @if ($active)<flux:badge size="sm" color="blue" class="-me-1">{{ $active }}</flux:badge>@endif
                </flux:button>
            </flux:modal.trigger>

            {{-- Desktop: the same two choices as labelled dropdowns --}}
            <div class="ms-auto flex items-center gap-2 max-sm:hidden">
                <flux:dropdown align="end">
                    <flux:button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="user-circle" icon:trailing="chevron-down">{{ $selectedChannel?->display_name ?? 'All channels' }}</flux:button>
                    <flux:menu>
                        <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="channel">
                            <flux:menu.radio value="">All channels</flux:menu.radio>
                            @foreach ($channels as $option)<flux:menu.radio value="{{ $option->youtube_channel_id }}">{{ $option->display_name }}</flux:menu.radio>@endforeach
                        </flux:menu.radio.group>
                    </flux:menu>
                </flux:dropdown>
                <flux:dropdown align="end">
                    <flux:button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="arrows-up-down" icon:trailing="chevron-down">{{ $sorts[$sort] }}</flux:button>
                    <flux:menu>
                        <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="sort">
                            @foreach ($sorts as $value => $label)<flux:menu.radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:menu.radio>@endforeach
                        </flux:menu.radio.group>
                    </flux:menu>
                </flux:dropdown>
            </div>
        </div>

        @if ($active)
            <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 sm:hidden">
                @if ($selectedChannel)<flux:badge size="sm">{{ $selectedChannel->display_name }} <flux:badge.close wire:click="$set('channel', '')" /></flux:badge>@endif
                @if ($sort !== 'newest')<flux:badge size="sm">{{ $sorts[$sort] }} <flux:badge.close wire:click="$set('sort', 'newest')" /></flux:badge>@endif
            </div>
        @endif

        <flux:modal name="feed-filters" variant="flyout" position="bottom" class="rounded-t-2xl p-6!">
            <flux:heading size="lg">Sort and channel</flux:heading>
            <flux:subheading class="mt-6 mb-2 font-medium">Sort</flux:subheading>
            <flux:radio.group wire:model.live="sort" variant="segmented" size="sm">
                @foreach ($sortsShort as $value => $label)<flux:radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:radio>@endforeach
            </flux:radio.group>
            <flux:subheading class="mt-6 mb-3 font-medium">Channel</flux:subheading>
            <flux:radio.group wire:model.live="channel" class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
                <flux:radio value="" label="All channels" />
                @foreach ($channels as $option)<flux:radio value="{{ $option->youtube_channel_id }}" label="{{ $option->display_name }}" />@endforeach
            </flux:radio.group>
            <flux:modal.close><flux:button variant="primary" class="mt-6 w-full">Show videos</flux:button></flux:modal.close>
        </flux:modal>
    @endif

    {{-- ============================================================ C: ONE-LINE CHIP ROW --}}
    @if ($design === 'c')
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <flux:heading size="xl" level="1">Feed <span class="font-normal text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">· {{ $remaining }}</span></flux:heading>
            <flux:tooltip content="Refresh all · last refreshed 3 minutes ago">
                <flux:button icon="arrow-path" variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Refresh all" />
            </flux:tooltip>
        </div>

        <div class="relative -mx-4 mt-4 sm:mx-0">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] sm:px-0">
                <flux:radio.group wire:model.live="filter" variant="pills" class="flex shrink-0 gap-2">
                    @foreach ($filters as $value => $label)<flux:radio value="{{ $value }}" class="py-1.5! px-3!">{{ $label }}</flux:radio>@endforeach
                </flux:radio.group>

                <div class="mx-1 h-5 w-px shrink-0 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></div>

                <flux:dropdown>
                    <button type="button" @class(['flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full py-1.5 px-3 text-sm font-medium leading-4', 'bg-zinc-800/6 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-white/10 dark:text-white/80' => $sort === 'newest', 'bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-800' => $sort !== 'newest'])>
                        <flux:icon.arrows-up-down variant="micro" class="opacity-60" />
                        {{ $sortsShort[$sort] }}
                        <flux:icon.chevron-down variant="micro" class="opacity-60" />
                    </button>
                    <flux:menu>
                        <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="sort">
                            @foreach ($sorts as $value => $label)<flux:menu.radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:menu.radio>@endforeach
                        </flux:menu.radio.group>
                    </flux:menu>
                </flux:dropdown>

                <flux:dropdown>
                    <button type="button" @class(['flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full py-1.5 px-3 text-sm font-medium leading-4', 'bg-zinc-800/6 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-white/10 dark:text-white/80' => $channel === '', 'bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-800' => $channel !== ''])>
                        @if ($selectedChannel)<img src="{{ route('avatars.show', $selectedChannel) }}" class="-ms-1 size-4 rounded-full" alt="">@endif
                        {{ $selectedChannel?->display_name ?? 'All channels' }}
                        <flux:icon.chevron-down variant="micro" class="opacity-60" />
                    </button>
                    <flux:menu>
                        <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="channel">
                            <flux:menu.radio value="">All channels</flux:menu.radio>
                            @foreach ($channels as $option)<flux:menu.radio value="{{ $option->youtube_channel_id }}">{{ $option->display_name }}</flux:menu.radio>@endforeach
                        </flux:menu.radio.group>
                    </flux:menu>
                </flux:dropdown>
            </div>
            <div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 end-0 w-8 bg-gradient-to-l from-white dark:from-zinc-800 sm:hidden"></div>
        </div>
    @endif

    {{-- ============================================================ D: SENTENCE --}}
    @if ($design === 'd')
        @php $link = 'inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 underline decoration-zinc-300 decoration-2 underline-offset-4 hover:decoration-zinc-500 dark:text-white dark:decoration-zinc-600'; @endphp
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <flux:heading size="xl" level="1">Feed</flux:heading>
            <flux:tooltip content="Refresh all · last refreshed 3 minutes ago">
                <flux:button icon="arrow-path" variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Refresh all" />
            </flux:tooltip>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-3 text-base leading-8 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Showing
            <flux:dropdown class="inline-block">
                <button type="button" class="{{ $link }}">{{ ['all' => 'everything', 'unwatched' => 'unwatched videos', 'saved' => 'saved videos'][$filter] }}<flux:icon.chevron-down variant="micro" class="opacity-50" /></button>
                <flux:menu>
                    <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="filter">
                        <flux:menu.radio value="all">Everything</flux:menu.radio>
                        <flux:menu.radio value="unwatched">Unwatched videos</flux:menu.radio>
                        <flux:menu.radio value="saved">Saved videos</flux:menu.radio>
                    </flux:menu.radio.group>
                </flux:menu>
            </flux:dropdown>
            from
            <flux:dropdown class="inline-block">
                <button type="button" class="{{ $link }}">{{ $selectedChannel?->display_name ?? 'all channels' }}<flux:icon.chevron-down variant="micro" class="opacity-50" /></button>
                <flux:menu>
                    <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="channel">
                        <flux:menu.radio value="">All channels</flux:menu.radio>
                        @foreach ($channels as $option)<flux:menu.radio value="{{ $option->youtube_channel_id }}">{{ $option->display_name }}</flux:menu.radio>@endforeach
                    </flux:menu.radio.group>
                </flux:menu>
            </flux:dropdown>
            sorted
            <flux:dropdown class="inline-block">
                <button type="button" class="{{ $link }}">{{ strtolower($sorts[$sort]) }}<flux:icon.chevron-down variant="micro" class="opacity-50" /></button>
                <flux:menu>
                    <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="sort">
                        @foreach ($sorts as $value => $label)<flux:menu.radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:menu.radio>@endforeach
                    </flux:menu.radio.group>
                </flux:menu>
            </flux:dropdown>
            <span class="whitespace-nowrap text-zinc-500">· {{ $remaining }} to watch</span>
        </div>
    @endif

    {{-- ============================================================ E: CHANNEL AVATAR STRIP --}}
    @if ($design === 'e')
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <flux:heading size="xl" level="1">Feed <span class="font-normal text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">· {{ $remaining }}</span></flux:heading>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                <flux:dropdown align="end">
                    <flux:button icon="arrows-up-down" variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Sort"><span class="max-sm:hidden">{{ $sorts[$sort] }}</span></flux:button>
                    <flux:menu>
                        <flux:menu.radio.group wire:model.live="sort">
                            @foreach ($sorts as $value => $label)<flux:menu.radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:menu.radio>@endforeach
                        </flux:menu.radio.group>
                    </flux:menu>
                </flux:dropdown>
                <flux:button icon="arrow-path" variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Refresh all" />
            </div>
        </div>

        <flux:radio.group wire:model.live="filter" variant="segmented" size="sm" class="mt-4 sm:max-w-80">
            @foreach ($filters as $value => $label)<flux:radio value="{{ $value }}">{{ $label }}</flux:radio>@endforeach
        </flux:radio.group>

        <div class="-mx-4 mt-3 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-4 pt-1 pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] sm:mx-0 sm:px-0">
            <button type="button" wire:click="$set('channel', '')" class="flex w-16 shrink-0 flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
                <span @class(['flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-700', 'ring-2 ring-zinc-800 ring-offset-2 dark:ring-white dark:ring-offset-zinc-800' => $channel === ''])><flux:icon.squares-2x2 class="size-5 text-zinc-500" /></span>
                <span @class(['w-full truncate text-center text-xs', 'font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-white' => $channel === '', 'text-zinc-500' => $channel !== ''])>All</span>
            </button>
            @foreach ($channels as $option)
                <button type="button" wire:click="$set('channel', '{{ $option->youtube_channel_id }}')" class="flex w-16 shrink-0 flex-col items-center gap-1.5" @if ($channel === $option->youtube_channel_id) x-init="$el.parentElement.scrollLeft = $el.offsetLeft - $el.parentElement.clientWidth / 2 + 32" @endif>
                    <img src="{{ route('avatars.show', $option) }}" alt="" @class(['size-12 rounded-full', 'ring-2 ring-zinc-800 ring-offset-2 dark:ring-white dark:ring-offset-zinc-800' => $channel === $option->youtube_channel_id, 'opacity-60' => $channel !== '' && $channel !== $option->youtube_channel_id])>
                    <span @class(['w-full truncate text-center text-xs', 'font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-white' => $channel === $option->youtube_channel_id, 'text-zinc-500' => $channel !== $option->youtube_channel_id])>{{ $option->display_name }}</span>
                </button>
            @endforeach
        </div>
    @endif

    <x-video-grid class="mt-5">
        @foreach ($videos as $video)
            <livewire:video-card :video="$video" :wire:key="'card-'.$video->id" />
        @endforeach
    </x-video-grid>
</section>
